current_affairs.title: Supreme Court Seven-Judge Bench Ruling on Sub-Categorization of SC/STs
current_affairs.summary: The Supreme Court of India ruled that states have the constitutional authority to create sub-categories within Scheduled Castes (SCs) and Scheduled Tribes (STs) to extend targeted affirmative action to the most disadvantaged groups within these categories.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper II: Indian Constitution—historical underpinnings, evolution, features, amendments, significant provisions and basic structure; Mechanisms, Laws, Institutions for vulnerable sections.

current_affairs.title: Addition of New Ramsar Sites to India's Network
current_affairs.summary: India has expanded its list of Wetlands of International Importance under the Ramsar Convention, bringing the total count to 85. The newly designated sites emphasize conservation efforts in critical biodiversity hotspots and coastal ecosystems.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III: Conservation, Environmental Pollution and Degradation, Environmental Impact Assessment; International Environmental Conventions.

current_affairs.title: Final Integration Phase of NASA-ISRO NISAR Satellite Mission
current_affairs.summary: The joint NASA-ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar (NISAR) mission enters its final pre-launch testing phase. Operating dual-frequency L-band and S-band radar, NISAR will track Earth's land-surface changes, glacier movements, and ecosystem dynamics globally every 12 days.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III: Science and Technology- developments and their applications and effects in everyday life; Achievements of Indians in science & technology; Space technology.

current_affairs.title: RBI Framework on Climate-Related Financial Risks and Green Finance
current_affairs.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) issued detailed guidelines for Regulated Entities (REs) regarding climate risk management, requiring financial institutions to disclose climate-related financial risks and implement green lending metrics.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper III: Indian Economy and issues relating to planning, mobilization of resources, growth, development, and sustainable finance.

current_affairs.title: BIMSTEC Connectivity Master Plan Roadmap Finalized
current_affairs.summary: Member nations of the Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC) adopted a concrete implementation strategy for the Master Plan for Transport Connectivity, focusing on port linkages, cross-border transport, and trade facilitation.
current_affairs.upsc_relevance: GS Paper II: Regional and Global Groupings and Agreements involving India and/or affecting India's interests; India and its Neighborhood relations.
